payload.reason: The evidence provides specific baseline methods used in the context of language learning and SLA modeling, including logistic regression, GBDT, and RNN, which are compared against the proposed multi-task learning method.

claims.text: The baseline methods include logistic regression (LR), GBDT, and RNN.
LR is a simple logistic regression using all the meta information and context information provided by datasets.
GBDT is the best method among all tree ensemble methods, using an ensemble of GBDTs with existing features.
RNN is the best method among all sequence modeling methods.
A new baseline GBDT+RNN combines the predictions of GBDT and RNN.
